snippet.title: Rugby League 26 | Official Gameplay Trailer | PS5, PS4
snippet.description:
GET READY FOR GREATNESS. Step onto the pitch in the most authentic Rugby League experience ever. Whether you're chasing club glory, building a custom Pro Team or rising through the ranks with a self made superstar, Rugby League 26 puts YOU at the heart of the action. Coming to PS5 and PS4 on 17th July 2025.

#rugbyleague #rugbyleague26 #nrl
